text:
jamie: Heads-up: we're throttling this week's release train rollouts and extending the canary window for release v3.4.2 by 2 hours. Observed increased 5xx in eu-west on the embeddings route. Pause non-critical deploys for next 2h.

deploy-bot: Automated canary extension: release=v3.4.2 canary_window=2h reason=observed-5xx region=eu-west initiated_by=jamie

priya: Noted. CPU on inference-pool-03 spiked alongside tail latency for long-context requests. Rolling avg error rate 1.9% -> 3.7% in last 12m.

dan: Is it correlated with quantized kernel switch or traffic pattern? Any model fallback triggered?

priya: Early signals point to kernel selection churn after the auto-optimizer picked the avx path for batch shapes >32. No fallback triggered yet — fallback policy still v3.3 as warm backup.

marisol: Can we throttle new traffic to eu-west and route to us-central until we stabilize? What's the safe traffic % to move?

jamie: Yes — recommended: shift 40% of new requests to us-central, keep 60% in eu-west so canary gathers signal. This buys time without blowing capacity. Update routing policy in Console: /console/routing -> create traffic-split rule.

ops_oncall: I pushed the routing change and bumped the per-node QPS cap from 120 -> 100 as a short-term backpressure. Watch for queue growth.

dan: If we need to revert the optimizer change, what's the command?

priya: Run the model variant rollback on canary hosts: ```
# on infra-runner
redwoodctl rollout revert --model redwood/emb-v3.4.2 --to-variant=v3.3 --scope=canary
```

jamie: Action items:
- priya: keep canary window + capture full traces and top-20 prompts (2h)
- dan: prepare rollback playbook and smoke tests (15m)
- marisol: notify affected customer success POCs for eu-west customers and update #support template
- ops_oncall: monitor queue length and GPU mem pressure, escalate if queue > 5000

marisol: I'll post a short customer-facing blurb after we confirm routing change stable.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics snapshot saved -> link: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/1971234567/snapshot (internal)

priya: After routing shift, 10m in: eu-west error rate down to 2.1%, cpu 78% -> 64%, tail latency still ~p95+25ms. continuing to collect.

dan: If rollback needed, we'll cut the revert and run smoke test `smoke-check.sh` against 5 endpoints first. Ready to cut if priya gives green.

jamie: Good. Pause non-critical merges for next 2h and avoid feature flag flips that touch embeddings. I'll post a deploy resumption notice when we have steady metrics or after 2h.

ops_oncall: I'll keep a live watch on the incident board. Ping me in thread if it spikes again :eyes:

jamie: Thanks everyone — next update ~ 30m or earlier if anything changes.
